args.body: Count the queued retail-data record retrieval against the existing two-FETCH allowance. Inspect the receipt and verify the returned OCID, release chronology, latest submission deadline and whether two original revisions are available. Compare changes in deadline, submission, requirements and attachment references. Treat changes to attachment references as metadata evidence only. On a fit, execute the comparison and the same-revision no-change control, then write the EN/FR bidder brief with specific checklist updates and source hashes. If the record cannot support a comparison, use the one remaining retrieval on the strongest saved candidate or record the precise gap if the allowance is exhausted. Read committed outputs before closure under a valid lease with a lesson. Retain independent review before public placement.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows no classified signals and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Retrieve its official revision history to test whether a bilingual amendment brief can save bidders reconciliation work. Proceed only if the official record confirms an open deadline and two comparable revisions. Any public placement requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.
